ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with an estimated 5-10% high-intensity (white/tan) coverage localized at the lobe tips and surface scratches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity field containing high-intensity pixel clusters at the far-left and far-right distal tips; sparse, fine-grained linear segments of high intensity are scattered across the interior surfaces of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees and a depth roughly 15% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary exhibiting moderate-frequency peaks and valleys; the right lobe trailing edge displays higher amplitude pixel variations and a more jagged profile than the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves fitted from the central notch to the outer tips of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast, textured pixel clusters localized at the distal extremities of both lobes, corresponding to localized surface encrustations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned, high-intensity linear streaks (1-3 pixels in width) that intersect the low-intensity ventral background, predominantly on the central and lower portions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of light-toned surface anomalies at both lobe tips and numerous distinct linear scars across the black fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly localized and dense concentration of high-intensity material exclusively at the distal margins, creating a sharp tonal contrast with the interior fluke body.
